section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1979
title: ## SUICIDES A total of 38217 suicides were reported in India during 1979 compared with the figure of 40207 in 1978 registering a decline of 4.9 percent in 1979 over 1978. The numerical decline registered during 1979 over 1978 was 1990. Incidentally the number of suicides in 1979 was the lowest in any one year since 1972. During the period 1972—79, the trend in suicide cases has been erratic. It is seen from the suicide figures that during the period of 8 years, the highest number of suicides was recorded during 1974 (46008) with a volume of 7·8 per lakh of population. If we see the volume only, the figures generally showed a downward trend except for 1974 but the actual number of suicides tell a different story as against 43601 suicides in 1972 it came down to 40807 in 1973 and again went up to 46008 in 1974. It came down continuously for three years again during 1975 to 1977 but went up again in 1978 to 40207 and came down to the lowest number in 1979 (38217). The detailed statistics are presented in Table-I.
